text:
Asha R: Quick sync — product asked for a lightweight audit view for auto-fallbacks. Must be non-scary and actionable.
Tom B: Can we do compact header: state badge, primary reason short, and a 3-dot menu for actions?
Kei N: I like: Badge: 'Degraded' (color amber). Reason: 'timeout p95 > 2.5s'. 3-dot menu: Retry, Pause policy (5m), Force-route (team). All RBAC-gated.
Sophie M: For auditors, we need an immutable event id and a downloadable bundle (ndjson) that includes decision metadata but not full PII unless allowed.
Asha R: Decision id + signed timestamp is fine. Also want a tiny inline graph: last 1h fallback rate sparkline and a small 'severity' pill.
Tom B: How to show sample retrieval? Option: show redacted prompt preview + 'Request raw (audit)' button which opens a consent modal and logs who fetched it.
Kei N: Backend taste: event payload = event_id, route, decision, triggers:{latency_p95, error_rate}, sample_ref (hash), retention_level, replay_allowed(boolean). Example: {"event_id":"evt-20250601-01","decision":"degrade","triggers":{"latency_p95_ms":2580}}
Sophie M: Add 'owner_team' and 'export_link' in enterprise bundles. Export should be S3 signed URL with ACL checks.
Asha R: UI: collapsed row in rollouts table, expand to a panel on the right with tabs: Overview, Traces, Sample, Actions, Audit.
Tom B: In Sample tab show 'sanitized_context' then 'fetch full sample' CTA grayed when retention expired. If grayed, show retention reason and link to compliance request flow.
Kei N: For probabilistic policies, show the score and the threshold and highlight if score within +/-5% of threshold.
Sophie M: Also surface cost impact when fallback is due to quota/cost routing: show units saved and estimated delta if forced.
ops-bot: Note: Operator safety: only users in group `ops_oncall` can 'force-route' for >50 reqs. Audit recorded.
Asha R: Replay: add 'send to sandbox' which strips user identifiers by default. Must be opt-in at team level.
Tom B: UX copy: use 'Degraded' upstream, 'Auto-switchover' internally. Also add small hover text: 'Why degraded?'.
Kei N: API stubs: GET /internal/rollouts/fallbacks/{event_id} and POST /internal/rollouts/fallbacks/{event_id}/export. Keep rate limits for exports.
Sophie M: Security asks: raw sample fetch requires KMS unwrap permission and a justification note stored with the audit bundle.
Asha R: Timeline: mock by Thursday, accessibility review Friday, security review next Mon.
deploy-bot: Staging rollout: rollout-fallback-ui-proto -> staging at 2025-06-13T09:00:00Z
Tom B: I'll drop initial mock links in #design after lunch.
Sophie M: Adding a quick runbook snippet to the panel: 'If fallback ratio > 15% for 30m, open infra ticket.'
Kei N: ok locking this as action items: Tom mock, Asha RBAC matrix, Sophie export flow, I'll update telemetry schema.
Asha R: Thanks team — ping me if privacy rules change for any market.
